sessionStart.bash: r="${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PWD}"; s="$r/scripts/bootstrap-check.sh"; if [ -f "$s" ]; then bash "$s"; else printf '{}'; fi

sessionStart.powershell: $r = $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT; if (-not $r) { $r = $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not $r) { $r = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if ($r) { try { [IO.Directory]::SetCurrentDirectory($env:USERPROFILE) } catch {}; $w = Join-Path (Join-Path $r 'scripts') 'invoke-context-contributor.ps1'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $w -PathType Leaf) { & $w 'budget-guidance@copilot-extensions' 'command-catalog' 'scripts/emit-command-catalog.ps1' } else { [Console]::Out.Write('{}') } } else { [Console]::Out.Write('{}') }
sessionStart.bash: r="${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; w="$r/scripts/invoke-context-contributor.sh"; if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$w" ]; then bash "$w" budget-guidance@copilot-extensions command-catalog scripts/emit-command-catalog.sh; else printf '{}'; fi
